# find

Select filesystem entries and run a supported action through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/find . -name '*.mbt' -print

moonx cli/find source-dir -type f -print0
```

Traverse supplied roots and evaluate supported name, path, type, size, time and access predicates.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-name VALUE` | Match entry names with a shell pattern. |
| `-type VALUE` | Test entry type, emptiness or size. |
| `-maxdepth VALUE` | Control traversal. |
| `-print` | Print paths followed by a newline. |
| `-print0` | Print paths followed by a NUL byte. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- Action combinations and -exec placement follow a limited grammar. Owner/inode and unavailable mode or identity queries are unsupported.
- Time predicates use the supported millisecond clock and bounded thresholds.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
